subject: Missing signup bonus in dashboard - CloudFin
messages:
From: Sam Wu <sam.wu@cloudfin.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudFin Billing <billing@cloudfin.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Signup bonus not showing after onboarding

Hi Evelyn,

We just completed the self-serve signup and connected our billing yesterday, but the $500 onboarding credit that the signup flow showed never appeared in our dashboard. We hit the account page and the balance still shows $0.00. I attached a screenshot of the dashboard and our signup receipt.

Details: 
- Account: CloudFin (billing@cloudfin.com)
- Signed up with coupon code: REDWOOD-ONBOARD-500
- Signup time: 2026-07-16T18:04:00Z

Can you confirm whether the credit was issued? Our trial use is already being consumed by dev testing and we want to avoid unexpected charges. If it's easier, feel free to apply the credit manually to our account.

Thanks,
Sam
Senior Cloud Architect
CloudFin

Attachment: screenshot-credit-balance.png
Attachment: signup-receipt.json

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@cloudfin.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signup bonus not showing after onboarding

Thanks for the report, Sam — sorry you're seeing this. I looped in Dev and Ops (Dev Patel and Marissa) to investigate. Quick next steps:

1) Dev, can you check the signup webhook and coupon reconciliation for CloudFin (customer email billing@cloudfin.com)? Sam says they used REDWOOD-ONBOARD-500.
2) Marissa, if we can't reconcile automatically within a few hours, can we apply the $500 credit manually under the account and confirm with Sam?

Sam — we'll follow up with findings and timeline by EOD PT. Appreciate the screenshots, very helpful.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signup bonus not showing after onboarding

On Fri, Jul 17, 2026 at 10:03 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the report, Sam — sorry you're seeing this. I looped in Dev and Ops (Dev Patel and Marissa) to investigate. Quick next steps:

I dug into the event logs: the signup webhook from 2026-07-16 18:04:12Z arrived and created the account, but the promotion reconciliation job failed with a coupon lookup miss. Our logs show coupon_id=\"onboard-500-v2\" while the public code maps to coupon_id=\"onboard-500\" (legacy id mismatch). The reconciliation retries errored with a 404 from the coupon service.

What I need from Billing for a manual grant:
- HubSpot deal id or internal account id (I have DEAL-7832 but confirm)
- Confirmation of the amount: $500

I'll put a hotfix in to accept either coupon_id mapping and re-run reconciliation, but that will take a deploy and a short backfill (~30-60 minutes). For immediate relief we can apply a manual credit to the account and record it.

Attaching the webhook payload and stripe charge for reference.

Attachment: stripe-charge-16234.pdf

— Dev

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@cloudfin.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signup bonus not showing after onboarding

Hi Sam — quick update from ops: we've manually added a $500 credit to the CloudFin account (internal id: acct_19982). You should see the balance reflected in the dashboard within a few minutes; please hard-refresh if it doesn't show immediately.

Notes: 
- Manual grant txn: TXN-20260718-0045 (reason: signup coupon reconciliation failure)
- I've flagged this for the billing team to ensure the chargeback/reconciliation is recorded properly with the finance ledger.

Evelyn — I also pushed a reconcile job that will attempt the re-run after Dev's hotfix to avoid double-grants. If the auto job succeeds, we'll cancel the manual grant reversal flow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Sam Wu <sam.wu@cloudfin.com>

Hi all — I can confirm the $500 credit is now visible in the account. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the manual grant. One small request: can you email a short note we can attach to our internal expense records confirming the manual credit and reason (signup coupon mismatch)? That will help our procurement team.

Thanks again — Sam
